FrameIndepentLerpRate(float, float, float)

Get a frame independent rate to use in lerp functions as t value.

public static float FrameIndepentLerpRate(float speed, float dt, float power = 2)

Parameters

speed float

Value has to be positive. A value of 1 means the halfway point is reached in 0.5 seconds. A value of 2 means twice as fast and so on.

dt float

The current delta time.

power float

The power to use.

Returns

float

Returns the rate to be used in lerp functions.
